text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the Representative Exchange 
Race, <chrname> was selected to represent Japan, 
while Gold Ship's name was not called.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship left the scene right away. Yet 
far from abandoning the project, she was 
already making moves for what was next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the big day approaching, Gold Ship 
promises to pour her entire heart and soul 
into supporting <chrname> during their overseas 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe campaign.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She felt she had to show a victory that 
would stun the world at the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe—a run that would live up to 
her expectations as well.
